items.title: Up to 30x More Work Per Watt: NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 Sets a New Efficiency Standard for AI Agents
items.summary: 这篇内容聚焦「Agent Skill、Harness、工具调用和自动化研发」。原文摘要显示：New on-silicon performance data measured by NVIDIA using real-world agentic coding trajectories shows Vera Rubin NVL72 systems deliver 30x higher throughput per megawatt and 35x lower token costs than NVIDIA GB300 NVL72.
items.insightText: 重点看任务拆分、工具编排、验证闭环和可复用工程抽象，判断能否迁移到 Auto-Research / Agent Coding 链路。
